name: Exam
description: The test screen: choose a policy (official 65-question mock, custom drill, pattern training, mistake review), then take the test with timer, question palette, mark-for-review, pause and a TCS-style submit summary.

settings.name: Default selection algorithm
settings.desc: How questions are prioritised inside your filters. You can still change it for each test.

settings.name: Ask why a question was wrong
settings.desc: After you submit, offer a quick tag for each wrong answer (careless, conceptual gap ...).

settings.name: Allow sub-tags
settings.desc: Write tags as Parent/Child in the list below to offer a second, more specific choice.

settings.name: Mistake tags
settings.default: Careless, Conceptual Gap/Formula, Conceptual Gap/Concept, Conceptual Gap/Condition, Anxiety, Slow, Typo

settings.name: Download a report when you submit
settings.desc: Saves a markdown file with every question, your answer and the result.
